blocks.text: Type and click across computers effortlessly with the Logitech MK955 Signature Slim Wireless Keyboard and Mouse Combo made out of recycled plastic (8).. Make work-life magic with customization and shortcuts that keep you in control of your wireless mouse and keyboard. Enjoy fast, precise scrolling and a familiar laptop-style keyboard feel that allows you to work even smarter with the Logi Options+ App’s custom shortcuts (3) (4) (5). Quiet keyboard typing and mouse clicking (7) give you more focus and less disturbance to others. Connect wirelessly with Bluetooth or the included Logi Bolt USB receiver, and stay concentrated for longer with up to 36 months of battery life for the wireless keyboard and 24 months for the wireless mouse (1) for larger hands.

items.label: Type and Click Across Your Personal and Work Computers
items.value: Move seamlessly between your home desktop and your work laptop with this wireless and quiet keyboard and mouse combo (2)(3)

items.label: Save Time Like Magic
items.value: Customizable keys, buttons and shortcuts for extended possibilities with the Logi Options+ App; available for Windows and macOS (3) (4) (5)

items.label: Enhance Your Space
items.value: A sleek and solidly built full-size bluetooth keyboard with familiar laptop-style typing and a comfortable, contoured, bluetooth mouse made of recycled plastic (8)

items.label: Quiet Experience
items.value: Conjure some focus time with quiet typing and clicking; the M750 L Signature Plus is a quiet click mouse with SilentTouch technology for 90% less click noise (7)

items.label: Easy Scrolling
items.value: With the M750 L Signature Plus wireless mouse for larger hands, you can scroll through documents line by line, or fly effortlessly through long web pages with the SmartWheel

items.label: Switch Between Your Laptop, Tablet, and Phone
items.value: The K950 Signature Slim Keyboard of this multi-device combo allows you to switch typing between three devices with a single tap

items.label: Works on Most Platforms
items.value: Worry-free wireless connection to Windows, macOS, Chrome OS, Linux, iPadOS, iOS and Android, easily pair via Bluetooth or Logi Bolt (2)(3)(5)(9)

items.label: Feel Good About Your Choice
items.value: Plastic parts in Slim Combo include certified post-consumer recycled plastic (minimum 48% for keyboard; 25% for mouse)(8)

items: In case of wireless keyboard or combo (keyboard and mouse), the USB receiver is usually provided either inside the mouse (under the battery cover) or attached within the product packaging
